summary.text: JD Vance is the Vice President of the United States and was elected U.S. Senator from Ohio in 2022. Before entering office he worked at Mithril Capital, a venture firm co-founded by Peter Thiel. In 2020 he launched the Cincinnati-based venture firm Narya Capital, whose reported backers included Thiel and Marc Andreessen.

facts.claim: In January 2020, Vance and partners were reported to have raised $93 million for Narya Capital, a new Cincinnati-based venture firm, with Peter Thiel and Marc Andreessen among the fund's backers.

connections.claim: Vance worked at Mithril Capital, a firm Peter Thiel co-founded. During Vance's 2022 Ohio Senate campaign, Thiel spent about $15 million supporting him, largely through the super PAC Protect Ohio Values.
